data.name: Smile Cities
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Smile Cities

When you visit Smile Cities, you will discover a world filled with happiness a city where every day is full of opportunity, hope, and the beautiful smiles of its people.

Experience a life of comfort and convenience. Travel effortlessly through modern business districts, enjoy delicious street food, meet friendly locals, and discover a new dream around every corner.

Whether you come to begin a new life, build a business, or search for a brighter future, Smile Cities is ready to offer you everything you desire.

Here, everyone has the chance to succeed.
Everyone can begin again.
And everyone has a reason to smile.

Smile Cities  A city of smiles. A city of opportunity. A city of the life you deserve.

ABOUT THE GAME

You will take on the role of Serena, a promising young woman who graduated from a prestigious university overseas.

After receiving news from her older brother, she returns to her hometown to care for her mother, who has been severely injured in an accident.

But once Serena arrives, she begins to realize that things are not as she remembers. A hidden truth may lie behind the accident, and the deeper she searches for answers, the further she is drawn into the darker side of the city.

Eventually, she comes to understand that This return home may mean she can never leave Smile Cities again.

Game Features

  • Explore a third-person open world set in a fictional city inspired by a blend of diverse cultures.

  • Experience Serena’s intense story and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the city’s surface.

  • Complete missions, earn money, build relationships, and unlock new opportunities.

  • Discover distinct districts, each with its own atmosphere, lifestyle, and activities.

  • Meet characters from different factions whose relationships and conflicts shape Serena’s journey.

  • Unlock new areas, missions, and activities as you progress through the game.

Wishlist now.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 , AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 , AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX1050 , AMD Readon RX580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
